# ceph_cluster_fsid (Data Source)

Reads the Ceph cluster's FSID (unique cluster identifier).

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "ceph_cluster_fsid" "this" {}

output "ceph_cluster_fsid" {
  value = data.ceph_cluster_fsid.this.fsid
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `fsid` (String) Unique identifier of the Ceph cluster.
